title: Account
description: One person's sign-in record, accounts/<id>.json in the private data repo, written by the sign-in Worker when someone creates an account with the family code. It holds no password and no key: the device stretches the password into a key (PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA-256, salt "court-sense/v1/" + id, 600,000 rounds, 32 bytes) and the Worker keeps SHA-256 of salt + key. Deleting the file resets the password; the person's progress under progress/<id>/ is untouched, and their sessions keep working.

id.description: The person's id: their name as a slug, and their folder under progress/. Permanent once used.

name.description: The name as typed when the account was created, shown in the app.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the salt bytes followed by the key bytes, base64url without padding.
